messages:
Mira Chen: Heads-up — found a weird edge where inline comments get dropped after the console linter autofix runs on save.
Tomas Rivera: repro steps? I can't repro locally.
Mira Chen: Open a route config with anchored headers + comments, toggle the guardrail lint and hit save quickly twice.
Mira Chen: Before:
```yaml
# customer intent: prefer region
routes:
  - match: /v1/*
    headers:
      x-region: &r eu-west-1 # prefer eu
```
Mira Chen: After (comments gone, anchor reordered):
```yaml
routes:
  - match: /v1/*
    headers:
      x-region: *r
```
Samir Patel: ugh. Sounds like our autofix run triggers a parse->serialize cycle that doesn't preserve comment nodes.
Samir Patel: Two quick ideas: 1) debounce save + lint for 1.5s, 2) switch serializer to preserve comments (yaml-surgeon roundtrip) for editor mode.
Tomas Rivera: Debounce helps UX but doesn't solve schema autofix that inserts/rewrites nodes. We need roundtrip or patch-level fixes.
Eden (bot): lint: header-anchor-order (warning) at routes[0].headers.x-region — suggested autofix applied.
Lisa Ng: For console telemetry we should add an event for "editor.autofix.applied" and include "preserve_comments=false" boolean so we can measure incidence.
Mira Chen: Good call — want counts before/after remediation. Also we should show an inline hint pill when autofix modifies anything: "Autofix applied — view diff" :eyes: 
Samir Patel: Prototype patch (pseudocode):
```js
// use yaml-surgeon style roundtrip
const doc = parseWithComments(src)
const fixed = applyAutofix(doc)
const out = serializePreservingComments(fixed)
```
Samir Patel: That preserves comments but is heavier CPU wise.
Tomas Rivera: Add unit tests: roundtrip preserve-comments, autosave-debounce integration, autofix-diff rendering.
Tomas Rivera: Edgecases: 1) anchors that reference nodes rearranged by autofix, 2) comments attached to mapping keys vs values.
Lisa Ng: Also map lint severity to UI: warn vs info vs error — telemetry should record severity so ops can tune rules.
Mira Chen: UX ask: Add an undo stack entry for autofix so users can press undo once to revert the autofix. Otherwise they lose manual edits.
Samir Patel: Agree — implement autofix as an editor operation (atomic) so undo/redo works natively.
Eden (bot): ci: added unit tests for yaml roundtrip on branch preserve-comments-137
Tomas Rivera: Will prototype debounce + autofix-as-op today. Samir — can you do the serializer perf test?
Samir Patel: Yep — I'll bench for 10k small docs and report.
Lisa Ng: I'll add telemetry schema and a dashboard tile: "editor.autofix rate / preserve_comments false" and a quick filter by rule id.
Mira Chen: Thanks. Action items: Tomas: debounce + integrate undo op; Samir: serializer perf + tests; Lisa: telemetry + dashboard; I'll mock the inline hint UI.
Tomas Rivera: assigning @Samir for serializer perf, @Lisa for telemetry.
Mira Chen: pinging devex for a tiny copy string for the hint: "Autofix applied — view changes" :memo:
Samir Patel: :thumbsup: 
Lisa Ng: :rocket: 
deploy-bot: scheduled preflight deploy to staging at 2026-04-01T22:00Z
Mira Chen: I'll follow up with a short repro gist and attach to the ticket.
